import '../src/css/base.css'; document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => { const res = await fetch('./games.json'); // mtn-vista-v1.2.glb const examples = await res.json(); console.log('examples', examples); const dev = document.querySelector('#game-list'); if (examples?.games?.length && dev) { const games = document.createElement('ul'); examples.games.forEach(game => { const gameItem = document.createElement('li'); const gameItemLink = document.createElement('a'); let uri = game.url; if (game.courseUrl) { uri += '?' + new URLSearchParams({ courseUrl: game.courseUrl}); } const gameItemPoster = document.createElement('img'); gameItemPoster.className = 'poster'; gameItemPoster.width = 160; gameItemPoster.height = 90; gameItemPoster.src = game.posterUrl; const gameItemTitle = document.createElement('div'); gameItemTitle.textContent = game.title; const gameItemType = document.createElement('div'); gameItemType.className = 'chip'; let type = 'Practice'; if (game.gameMode === 1) { type = 'Game' } else if (game.gameMode === 2) { type = 'Course' } gameItemType.textContent = type; gameItemLink.append(gameItemPoster, gameItemTitle, gameItemType); // gameItemLink.textContent = game.title; gameItemLink.setAttribute('href', uri); gameItem.append(gameItemLink); games.append(gameItem); }); dev.append(games); } });
